title: Donchian multi-lookback ensemble, long-only, inverse-vol weights, with a no-trade band (lit review 2026-10-21 candidate 3)
source: Zarattini, Pagani, Barbon (2025) 'Catching Crypto Trends' SFI RP 25-80 (unreplicated, numbers unverified); arXiv 2602.11708 (vol-scaled crypto trend)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). Daily vectorised simulation, not a freqtrade backtest; a PASS licenses a separately pre-registered freqtrade strategy, nothing is adopted.
data: user_data/data/binanceus 15m, aggregated to UTC days (open = first bar open, high max, low min, close = last close)

signal.per_lookback_state: goes 1 when close_t >= max(high over the L days before t); goes 0 when close_t <= min(low over the ceil(L/2) days before t); otherwise unchanged; starts 0
signal.ensemble: s_i,t = mean of the six states, in [0, 1]
signal.eligible: pair has at least 160 prior days of data and a 30-day vol

weights.vol: sigma_i = std of the last 30 daily log close returns (min 20)
weights.target: w_i = s_i * (1/sigma_i) / sum over ELIGIBLE j of (1/sigma_j); sum <= 1, remainder in cash at 0 %
weights.timing: weights from day t's bars fill at day t+1's open (first 15m bar) and earn open(t+1) -> open(t+2)

arms.band (PRIMARY): held weights drift with returns; pair i is traded to its target only if |target - held| > 0.02
arms.noband (descriptive): every pair traded to target every day

costs: 15 bp per unit of |weight traded| (30 bp round trip), every arm and comparator

comparator.EW (primary): equal weight over the same eligible pairs, rebalanced on the first day of each month, same fill timing and costs
comparator.live basket (descriptive only): freqtrade backtesting of Basket/MomentumRegimeBasket15m with config/config_mom_15m.json (75 pairs, current defaults) on each half; total return, Sharpe, max DD from its report. Different universe -- context, not a pass condition.

start: every book starts in cash on the early start; both halves are scored on one continuous run (positions carry across the boundary)
metrics: per half: net and gross CAGR, Sharpe of daily net returns (x sqrt 365), max drawdown, turnover per year, cost per year, mean exposure

rule.primary: PASS iff, for the band arm, in BOTH halves: net Sharpe > 0 AND net Sharpe > EW net Sharpe; AND pooled over both halves a paired stationary block bootstrap (mean block 20 days, 5000 draws, seed 0) gives one-sided p <= 0.05 for net Sharpe(band) - net Sharpe(EW) > 0
rule.inconclusive: fewer than 6 eligible pairs on more than 10 % of days in either half

run: queued after the 040 mt_ls queue (with the live-basket freqtrade backtests); CPU only
